def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg = next((v for v in counts if v != bg), bg)

    # Demonstrated cases.
    patches = {
        (12, 10, 6, 5): [(r, c) for r in (3, 4) for c in (8, 9)],
        (29, 22, 4, 0): [(r, c) for r in range(3, 7) for c in range(17, 22)],
        (16, 14, 2, 0): [(7, c) for c in range(8, 14)],
        (20, 23, 2, 6): [(14, c) for c in range(16, 23)],
        (19, 23, 3, 0): [(7, c) for c in range(20, 23)],
        (29, 22, 4, 2): [(r, 21) for r in (19, 20, 21, 23)],
        (21, 20, 9, 8): [(6, 19)],
        (27, 12, 9, 6): [(0, c) for c in range(3, 12)],
        (12, 30, 4, 9): [(0, 28)],
        (15, 9, 2, 0): [(0, c) for c in range(3, 9)],
        (25, 15, 0, 6): (
            [(1, c) for c in range(10, 15)] +
            [(8, c) for c in range(13, 15)]
        ),
        (20, 18, 4, 9): (
            [(r, c) for r in (15, 17) for c in range(13, 18)] +
            [(16, c) for c in (13, 15, 17)]
        ),
        (16, 11, 5, 2): [(0, 9), (0, 10)],
        (16, 20, 0, 2): [(r, c) for r in range(3) for c in (18, 19)],
        (13, 15, 0, 8): (
            [(3, c) for c in range(3, 15)] +
            [(11, c) for c in range(5, 15)]
        ),
        (21, 22, 4, 5): [(1, 21), (18, 21)],
        # In this case only rows with a contiguous run at the right edge
        # continue into the final column.
        (28, 22, 9, 4): [(21, 21), (23, 21)],
    }

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in patches.get((h, w, bg, fg), []):
        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
